name: identity_asset_ingest
title: Add an image or texture to FX Studio
description: Ingests an image/logo/texture from HTTPS or base64 into the account's asset library. Without project_id it serves account authoring; an accessible Project selects its account. Returned asset IDs listed in a scene's settings.asset_ids admit those exact bytes to the isolated scene runtime. A scene has no ambient network or account credentials.

project_id.description: Project public ID; this is the account boundary for the uploaded asset.

url.description: HTTPS image URL to fetch; exactly one of url or data_base64.

data_base64.description: Base64 image bytes, optionally as a data:image/...;base64 URL; exactly one of data_base64 or url.

kind.description: logo for a brand mark/wordmark asset; image for supporting imagery.

examples.label: Upload a logo for a new brand

asset.description: Account-scoped asset ref with asset_id, kind, content_type, sha256, and authenticated url.
